ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white regions occupy the central interior of both fluke lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and median notch, with heavy striated mottling and linear streaks extending into the white interior regions. Dark pigmentation is most concentrated at the proximal base near the notch and along the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 62 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending significantly toward the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations with high frequency along the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged peaks and pixel-level valleys are concentrated on the distal third of the right lobe and the outermost tip of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a broad convex curvature from the median notch to the tips, while the visible portions of the leading edges show a sharp convex taper toward the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle attachments) are visible on the outermost margins and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the white surfaces of both lobes. Specifically, prominent diagonal and vertical streaks are present on the mid-to-outer sections of the right lobe and the upper-mid section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake marks (orca tooth scarring) across both lobes. Minor edge nicks and irregularities along the trailing boundary, particularly on the right lobe distal edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white-water occlusion (splash) masks the lower-central junction of the fluke lobes and peduncle.
